ops.title: Project permission words without unrelated tool bodies
ops.description: Owner: /root/ccx_related_topk_ship. Confirmed source TranscriptSources.said requests full Turn.events/tool_uses but consumes only prompt/started_at, human QueuedCommand text+timestamp, user-rejected result content/name/timestamps, and preceding assistant last-nonempty text tail. agent_before builds a global prompt-keyed last-wins map and may apply that mapping to matching queued/rejection text too; preserve this subtle contract. Next: design additive compact native turn projection using existing ActivityIndex and generation ownership, with full existing said output as oracle. Avoid complete ToolUse or successful tool-result serialization; no global cache/new permission failure policy. Preserve Python strip/Unicode last400 semantics explicitly, duplicate prompts, exact chronology, window/classifier/trust/revocation and fixed-lease lifetime. Keep API124/SDK20/body publisher independent.

ops.text: Native compact projection and Capt said output match full-turn oracle for Unicode whitespace/tails, repeated prompts, queued human vs machine, rejected tool results, timestamps, cross-source trust and fresh revocation.
Real source/work/output-byte CI proves unrelated successful tool payloads are never cloned/serialized; memory charged by existing generation ledger and lifetime reviewed.
Independent review/full CI/normal merge/public release/local guarded install and affected-case verification completed; no physical recovery claim without host proof.
